name: bb-plugin-bb-lively
description: bb plugin: a lively palette theme and a motion layer of quick, subtle micro-interactions for bb, honouring reduced motion.

bb.name: Lively [Experimental]
bb.description: Quick, subtle motion for bb (presses, new messages rising in, menu springs, send and status pulses) on any theme, plus optional Lively palettes. Follows your OS reduced-motion setting.

themes.name: Lively
themes.description: Warm neutrals, a soft violet accent, rounder corners and springier transitions

themes.name: Lively Dracula
themes.description: bb's Dracula palette with Lively's corners, elevation and transition timing

scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace core && oxlint --config core/.oxlintrc.json --type-aware app.tsx server.ts adapter tests
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test && bb plugin build
